tables.name: Tickets
tables.description: Decomposes service requests into structured incident records tracked from creation to resolution. Serves as the primary intake point for customer issues, with outbound links to locations, jobs, agents, and SLA records. Records progress through discrete lifecycle stages (Open → Pending → Resolved → Closed) with duration tracking, SLA monitoring, and optional compensation triggering for out-of-hours or multi-day incidents. Operates as a bridge table in the incident workflow, linking customer-reported issues to operational resources and resolution tracking.

tables.name: OOS items
tables.description: Decompose out-of-stock menu item requests from parent tickets into individually tracked remediation tasks. Each record represents a single menu item unavailability period at a specific location screen, with start/end timestamps and request type classification (Add/Remove/Extend). Status progresses from Todo to Done as items return to availability.

tables.name: Menu items
tables.description: Represent the reference catalog of QSR menu items tracked for out-of-stock monitoring. Provides controlled vocabulary for OOS item decomposition with bilingual naming (Thai/English) and active/inactive status management.

tables.name: Agents
tables.description: Map Freshdesk agent names to Airtable collaborator accounts for ticket assignment synchronization. Bridges external Freshdesk user identity with internal Airtable user identity, enabling agent assignment visibility across both systems.

tables.name: Ticket log
tables.description: Capture audit trail of ticket status transitions. Each record represents a single status change event with timestamp, user, and status value, providing complete lifecycle reconstruction capability for compliance and process analysis.

tables.name: SLA
tables.description: Define resolution time thresholds for ticket categories based on Customer and Service line combinations. Each record establishes a duration target (in minutes) against which ticket performance is measured, with automatic SLA compliance percentage calculation from linked ticket resolution timestamps.

tables.name: Compensation
tables.description: Define compensation rate rules that determine when and how much compensation applies to tickets based on creation time, daypart, and day-of-week criteria. Rules operate in Default or Override mode, with Override type supporting week-specific applicability for seasonal or promotional periods.

tables.name: Weeks
tables.description: Represent weekly calendar periods for compensation override scoping. Each record defines a specific week number + year pair with start/end dates, enabling precise temporal scoping of time-bound compensation rules.
